::: {.eyebrow}
Contact
:::

I usually reply within a few days. Prefer email? Write to
[totalegezondheidbv@gmail.com](mailto:totalegezondheidbv@gmail.com).

```{=html}
<form name="contact-en" method="POST" data-netlify="true" style="max-width:520px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem">
  <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="contact-en">
  <label>Name
    <input name="name" required class="form-control">
  </label>
  <label>Email address
    <input name="email" type="email" required class="form-control">
  </label>
  <label>Subject
    <select name="subject" class="form-select">
      <option>Research</option>
      <option>Collaboration</option>
      <option>Practice intake</option>
      <option>Other</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label>Message
    <textarea name="message" rows="6" required class="form-control"></textarea>
  </label>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" style="align-self:start;padding:.6rem 1.6rem">Send</button>
</form>
```

The form runs on Netlify Forms. Every submission lands in the Netlify dashboard,
and is forwarded by email to totalegezondheidbv@gmail.com.
